pages.title: Eco Jungle Resort Escape for a Belize Rainforest Getaway
pages.description: Discover an eco jungle resort with upgraded amenities in Belize. Enjoy a unique Belize rainforest getaway surrounded by ancient Maya history.
pages.text:
Eco Jungle Resort Escape for a Belize Rainforest Getaway
Belize Jungle Retreat
All-Inclusive Eco-Luxury Resort
The Belizean Rainforest Awaits
I
4.8 / 5 | 365 + reviews
All-Inclusive Package
Retreats
Book Entire Property
Vacation Packages
Prepare For An Elemental Experience
Enjoy the dawn chorus of birds, morning mists and early sunrises peeking through the ancient hardwood trees. Dip your toes in the crystal-clear stream or walk under the towering canopy. This is nature in her full regalia.
Call or Text to Book
+1 (406) 646-3725
Book Your All-Inclusive Stay
Daily jungle and Maya cultural activities, traditional thatch-roof cabana stay, all meals and local drinks, 300-acre private reserve, and round-trip airport transportation included.
All-Inclusive Details
Retreats To Enhance Your Experience
Jade is a place that provides physical, mental and emotional space from your daily life, so you can refocus, recharge, and ensure you’re living a life true to your best and truest self. Enhance your All-Inclusive stay experience with one of our Retreat Packages.
Find a Retreat
Explore 300 Acres of Rainforest
On-site Activities
With 300 acres of primary forest, miles of trails, ancient Maya Sites, three swimming holes, a 5 acre meadow, swing bridges, and our farms to explore, there’s plenty to do and see without going anywhere!
View Activities
Venture Out Into Belize
Off-site Activities
Home to rich biodiversity, extensive caves, and diverse culture, we offer endless adventures. From waterfall hikes to Maya temples, our expert guides ensure unforgettable experiences every day.
View Activities
Book the Entire Property
Why settle for a room when you can have a 300-acre jungle kingdom all to yourself? No crowds. No compromises. Just your group and nature, completely uninterrupted.
Book Entire Property
Things at
Dining | massage | Birding | Maya sites | Hiking | river
Nearby Experiences
Belizean Adventures
ATM Cave
Jade is the closest resort in the country to this incredible archaeological discovery. Adventure into Xibalba, the Maya underworld, by entering Actún Tunichíl Muknal, the cave of the stone sepulcher.
Learn More
Maya Sites
Belize anciently had a population 10x its current population. Visit Tikal, Caracol, Xunantunich and other sites that have been restored in Belize and Guatemala.
Learn More
Butterfly Farm
Many species of butterflies live at Jade and in the surrounding jungles of Belize. Experience up-close experiences with these beautiful creatures at a nearby butterfly farm!
Learn More
Cave Tubing
Escape into the Maya Underworld with our cave tubing tour. Hike through the jungle canopy and then enjoy a lazy float through the cave. For adventurers, enjoy a jump from the rock at the end of your ride.
Learn More
Zip Lining
Fly through the jungle canopy and over the river in a series of thrilling zip lines, the longest of which is over 1,000 feet!
Learn More
Hidden Waterfalls
Visit the beautiful protected area of Mountain Pine Ridge, which is home to many waterfalls. Hike down to Big Rock Falls and enjoy a swim or cliff jumping in the waterfall pool. How deep does it go? No one knows.
Learn More
Accommodations
Eco-Luxury Stays
Thatch cabanas surround an ancient Maya site and look out over the jungle canopy. Each has a private bathroom with hot water and 24-hour electricity with a ceiling fan. We operate sustainably with water from the nearby stream, power from the sun, and food from the property and local growers.
View Accommodations
Retreats
Find Space & Renewal
You just get to Belize International Airport, and we will handle the rest! All ground transportation, accommodations, meals, adventures, activities and classes are included in the retreat.
View Our Retreats
Sustainability
Local Impact
We are not just investing in resorts, sustainability and conservation. We are also investing in the local communities and economy . We have already added 25+ good jobs to the local economy and given significant contracts to local artisans and other workers.
Learn More
Dining
Prepare To Be Delighted
The traditions of Mayan cooking have been integrated into the dining experience at Jade Jungle Resort. You will dine to lamplight with family, friends, or fellow travelers in a communal dining room that includes ancient hardwood tables, views of the jungle and Mayan-inspired design.
Learn More
Jade Offers Healthy and Flavorful Meals With Just a Touch of Indulgence
Learn More
About Jade
Meet The Walker Family
The Walker Family relocated from Salt Lake City, Utah to Belize in Spring of 2023 to chase their wild dreams of building an adventure, health and wellness resort.
Central to the lodge location is an ancient Maya Plaza that was partially restored from 1999-2004. In 2023 Mineral Resorts purchased the property to expand on the work and positive reputation of the original owners. Since that time we have updated the accommodations and added more amenities and accommodations to improve your stay.
You can follow our journey on Instagram and YouTube .
Learn More Contact Us
